# hackerone_scope_exclusion (Resource)

Manages an out-of-scope entry (scope exclusion) for a HackerOne program.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `category` (String) Asset category of the exclusion (e.g. `url`, `cidr`, `apple_store_app_id`).
- `program_id` (String) Numeric ID of the program.

### Optional

- `details` (String) The identifier being excluded (e.g. the URL or CIDR).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID in the form `program_id/exclusion_id`.
